The '''Methane Fix Cantina''' was a dining establishment in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was located on [[Dune Street/Legends|Dune Street]], next door to the wreckage of the [[Dowager Queen/Legends|''Dowager Queen'']].
